## Change and reason

Describe the concrete consumer behavior and why it belongs in Zigil.

## Verification and limitations

Report actual commands, compiler, target/modes and results. Include ownership,
compatibility, failure-path and package-consumer impacts where applicable.

## AI assistance

Tool/model if known, extent and scope; what a human actually checked:

## Human review

- [ ] Read and understand the complete diff.
- [ ] Verify checks, ownership, compatibility and failure behavior.
- [ ] Review attribution, private-data exclusions and AI disclosure.

An agent must not check these boxes for a human.
